subject: PO metadata normalization, invoice cadence, and discount slab applicability
messages:
From: Lisa Huang <procurement@stromline.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: PO requirements + discount slab question
Attachments: vendor_po_template.xlsx (attachment stub)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — Stromline is moving quickly on the evaluation. Before legal/finance sign-off we need to confirm a few procurement constraints so we can generate a valid PO from our ERP. Can you confirm the following?

- PO fields we require to be present for your billing to map correctly: PO_ID, BILL_TO_ENTITY, BU_CODE, CONTRACT_LINE (SKU id), and PO_TYPE (values: COMMIT, PREPAY, USAGE). Our system will only accept structured POs that include BU_CODE.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 45. Is Redwood able to accept Net 45 for this agreement? If there’s a discount tied to Net30/Net15 we need to know how much it moves the price.
- Invoice cadence: we’d like to invoice weekly (multiple POs per month is normal for us). Will that break any discount slab or committed-usage logic on your side?
- Discount slab: you mentioned a volume-based slab in the pricing matrix. Does the slab apply to invoiced amounts or to committed (purchase order) amounts? We need the rule so AP can route approvals.

Attached is our standard vendor PO template so legal can see the fields. Can you also provide a one‑page summary of how discounts are applied (PO vs invoice, field triggers, and whether multiple PO lines aggregate toward a slab)?

Thanks — if easier, happy to hop on a 20‑minute call with finance today.

Best,
Lisa Huang
Head of Procurement
Stromline Therapeutics
procurement@stromline.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Huang <procurement@stromline.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO requirements + discount slab question

Hi Lisa — thanks, and appreciate the clear template. Short answers up front, details below:

- We can accept Net 45, but the standard pricing matrix assumes Net 30. If you require Net 45 we can offer a mid‑point concession (2% smaller discount on the committed slab tiers) unless a prepay PO is provided.
- Our slab discount is evaluated on the "billable invoiced amount" by billing period, but we will honor aggregation of multiple PO lines and multiple POs from the same legal entity during a calendar month for tier qualification (we do need PO metadata normalized — see below).
- Weekly invoices are fine; they will aggregate for slab qualification, but invoice cadence affects cashflow only — the Net term applies per invoice.

Important PO normalization rules for our AP system (we can provide a mapping script):
- Required exact field names: PO_ID, BILL_TO_ENTITY, BU_CODE, CONTRACT_LINE, PO_TYPE. PO_TYPE values we recognize: COMMIT, PREPAY, USAGE. POs missing BU_CODE will be rejected by our ERP mapping.
- For slab aggregation: we match on BILL_TO_ENTITY + BU_CODE across all PO lines and POs in the same calendar month.
- If a PO is labeled PO_TYPE=PREPAY and includes a prepayment memo, the customer receives the full slab discount regardless of invoicing cadence (prepay overrides netterm discount shrink).

Attached: a concise pricing matrix and an example normalized PO JSON we can accept. I copied Finance and Sales to confirm the concession and recording.

Next step: Vanessa, can you confirm the revised slab numbers and prepare an authorization memo if we accept Net45 with the 2% tradeoff?

— Mina

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Huang <procurement@stromline.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 17:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO requirements + discount slab question

Thanks Mina / Lisa — quick commercial clarification from pricing.

- Baseline: our published committed slabs are: 0–50k (0%), 50k–250k (7%), 250k–1M (12%), >1M (18%) based on ARR-equivalent billed amounts per calendar month. These assume Net30.
- Concession for Net45: reduce each slab discount by 2 percentage points (e.g., 7% -> 5%). This is our standard tradeoff unless a PREPAY PO is provided.
- Prepay treatment: PO_TYPE=PREPAY with a prepayment memo and proof of payment gives immediate slab credit at time of payment. Prepay does not require Net30.
- Weekly invoices: acceptable. We will aggregate all invoices for slab qualification on a calendar month basis as long as the PO metadata matches (BILL_TO_ENTITY + BU_CODE).

Operational asks (to Stromline AP):
- Please include BU_CODE in POs and ensure CONTRACT_LINE uses SKU bundle codes (we provided the SKU mapping in pricing_matrix_Sept2027.xlsx).
- When submitting multiple POs that should aggregate, add the header tag AGG_GROUP=MONTHLY_<YYYYMM> in an optional PO_NOTE field so our ingestion has a deterministic join key (this is optional but recommended).

If Stromline agrees we can draft a one‑page addendum to the SOW clarifying PO field requirements and the Net45 concession. Ben — I included you to make sure billing can produce the weekly invoice sample.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Deals & Pricing
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Huang <procurement@stromline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:09:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO requirements + discount slab question

Thanks Vanessa — that largely works for us. A few follow-ups from AP:

- Our ERP will not allow a custom PO_NOTE field to be reliably populated for every PO. Can you accept aggregation without AGG_GROUP if BILL_TO_ENTITY + BU_CODE match? That would be preferable for us.
- For Net45 concession: Stromline can accept Net45 as long as the discount bands are documented and we have a line item on the invoice that references the originating PO_ID(s).
- One edge case: if we submit a PREPAY PO for a portion of the commitment and weekly invoice for usage overage, will the PREPAY portion still secure the slab for that month?

If you confirm the three points above, I can push to legal and AP and send a sample populated PO this afternoon. If useful, we can skim the SOW addendum in a quick call at 3pm ET today.

Best,
Lisa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Huang <procurement@stromline.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO requirements + discount slab question

Hi Lisa — Ben on Billing. Quick confirmations: 

- Aggregation: we will aggregate by BILL_TO_ENTITY + BU_CODE if AGG_GROUP is missing. We'll log a warning when AGG_GROUP is not present but will still join by the two required fields.
- PREPAY partial: PREPAY amounts posted and tied to the same BILL_TO_ENTITY + BU_CODE will count toward the slab immediately at receipt-of-payment. Any weekly usage invoices will aggregate with the PREPAY for slab calculation the same month.
- PO_ID on invoice: we will include the originating PO_ID(s) in the invoice line metadata. If multiple PO_IDs map to one invoice, we will list them comma-separated in the PO reference field.

Action items: Mina will attach the SOW addendum (one pager) and the pricing matrix; Stromline to send a populated sample PO so we can validate ingestion.

Thanks — attaching the sample SOW addendum now.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_Stromline_v2.pdf (attachment stub), pricing_matrix_Sept2027.xlsx (attachment stub)
